Name: G0966's Basic Floors Pack
Author: G0966
Description:
This mod adds simple floor textures that match the base game's walls and furniture better.
I've also referred to other creators' wallpaper mods in order to make sure the floor colours blend well with most of them.

Compatible with Happy Home Designer Mod (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675). Added floor textures can be acquired using the Catalogue.

Installation Guide:
1. Install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher
2. Download the .zip file for the mod
3. Extract the .zip folder into ~/Stardew Valley/Mods
4. Run the game using SMAPI


Wallpaper mods used in the in-game screenshot: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27122 & https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11168
